justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/loading/ClassLoadingStrategy.java` (nested class at lines 292-426). `WrappingDispatcher` is a compact strategy helper with 7 state fields, 2 constructors, and 6 small methods; all methods are tightly focused on one concern: configuring and delegating class loading to `ByteArrayClassLoader`/`ByteArrayClassLoader.ChildFirst`. I did not see multiple unrelated responsibilities, large method bodies, or evidence of separable cohesive clusters, so insufficient modularization is not indicated.
